fc149bdda052a23ffe9a6a7bae0d8f71d08a8a5f.summary: Project page for godoh, a proof-of-concept command-and-control framework written in Go that uses DNS-over-HTTPS as its transport. It lists Google and Cloudflare as supported providers and traditional DNS as an option. It covers installation, command usage and licensing (GNU GPL v3). It is a software project page, not a threat intelligence report, and is marked as archived.
hedges: The page describes godoh as a proof of concept.
